entries.description: ASPEED d8/d6 interface: pending stateful adapter
entries.constraints: Monitoring only. X570D4U firmware 1.35 uses raw duty 15..63 and requires reading current duty and limiting each change to 8 raw units. Stateless percentage templates cannot safely express this; no write commands shipped. Other ASRock firmware differs.

entries.description: AST2600 percentage interface documented in TSDQA-72
entries.constraints: Select explicitly only after verifying the controller is an ASRock Rack AST2600 with the documented 0xd0 interface. Whole-system 16-slot control; no BMCForge hardware verification. Not compatible with AST2500 or older 0x3a/0x01 boards.

entries.description: PowerEdge iDRAC 6/7/8 OEM whole-system fan duty
entries.constraints: Community-documented OEM commands; no BMCForge hardware verification. Excludes R210 II due to reported different behavior. Firmware must be checked on the actual device.

entries.description: PowerEdge 14G with legacy iDRAC9 firmware only
entries.constraints: Known firmware restrictions from 3.34 onward; exact compatibility must be verified. Newer generations are monitoring-only by default.

entries.description: Standard IPMI sensor monitoring
entries.constraints: Monitoring only. IPMI support does not imply OEM fan control support.

entries.description: China Greatwall / 中国长城 standard IPMI monitoring (no fan writes)
sources: https://www.greatwall.com.cn/category/智慧计算与存储/通用型服务器
entries.constraints: Standard IPMI monitoring when supported/enabled by the installed platform and firmware. BMC/OEM implementations vary across CPU platforms. A catalog entry is not a promise of IPMI availability or raw fan control.

entries.description: H3C / 新华三 standard IPMI monitoring (no fan writes)
entries.constraints: Standard IPMI monitoring for UniServer HDM. HDM fan-speed policy and configuration reload are not the UIS OEM PWM interface. No fixed-duty or automatic-recovery sequence is enabled for HDM by this profile.

entries.description: UIS 2000 G6 OEM fan PWM, signature-probed experimental interface
entries.constraints: Only the UIS 2000 G6 OEM protocol, not UniServer HDM. Documentation introduces fan mode in 1.01.07; standard Device ID does not establish that full version. A read-only Get Fan Mode must return exactly aa e5 00 00 before any takeover. Signature/byte-order mismatch fails closed; no alternate prefixes are tried. Only the five documented PWM percentage points are exposed. Response bytes are checked after writes. Requires explicit experimental enablement; no BMCForge hardware verification.

entries.description: HPE / HP standard IPMI monitoring (no fan writes)
entries.constraints: Standard IPMI monitoring when LAN access and suite 3 are enabled. HPE fan values can be percentages or states rather than RPM; retain reported units. Common community fan-write solutions need patched iLO/SSH, outside this native IPMI adapter. Use the per-device iLO credentials; no shared password is assumed.

entries.description: Huawei / 华为 standard IPMI monitoring (no fan writes)
entries.constraints: Standard IPMI monitoring for supported iBMC LAN configurations. CLI fanmode/fanlevel and Redfish are not native IPMI command evidence; no raw fan writes are enabled.

entries.description: IBM / Lenovo System x IMM and IMM2 standard IPMI monitoring
entries.constraints: Standard IPMI monitoring requires enabled LAN access and a supported cipher suite. Includes x3550 M5 types 5463 and 8869. No fan writes: x3650 M5 bank commands are not evidence for other System x models. Use the configured device credentials. Catalog recognition is not hardware verification.

entries.description: Inspur / 浪潮 standard IPMI monitoring (no fan writes)
entries.constraints: Standard IPMI monitoring. Vendor WebUI manual fan controls do not establish a portable raw-IPMI write and automatic recovery sequence. BMC families differ; do not reuse Dell raw commands. Use configured device credentials.

entries.description: System x3550 M5 IMM2 fan limit and release (user-supplied scripts)
entries.constraints: Command evidence: user-supplied limit.sh and unlimit.sh for x3550 M5; see docs/models.md. Product sources establish model identity only, not OEM command endorsement. Limit: 3a 07 <bank> 10 01; release: 3a 07 <bank> 12 00. Only raw 0x10 is supported, with no percentage/RPM interpretation or bank-location assumption. Firmware scope is unknown; no BMCForge hardware validation. Recovery is recorded before bank writes and attempted independently for each affected bank.

entries.description: System x3650 M5 IMM2 independent fan banks, raw levels
entries.constraints: Protocol facts independently implemented from the public IMM2 implementation. No BMCForge hardware validation. Values are raw non-linear levels, NOT percentages. Bank 1 front/CPU1, bank 2 rear/CPU2. Automatic recovery is recorded before every attempted bank write.

entries.description: ThinkSystem XClarity Controller standard IPMI monitoring
entries.constraints: Recognition and standard IPMI monitoring when LAN/suite 3 are enabled. XCC is not IMM2: the x3650 M5 raw bank protocol is never applied to ThinkSystem. Use the configured account or device label; do not assume legacy IMM2 credentials for every XCC generation.

entries.description: Sugon / Dawning / 曙光 standard IPMI monitoring (no fan writes)
entries.constraints: Standard IPMI monitoring. Platform-specific full-speed and advanced-user commands from benchmark reports do not prove return to BMC automatic mode on these models; no raw fan writes are enabled.

entries.description: ATEN BMC X10-X13/H10-H13 two-zone duty control
entries.constraints: Select explicitly after checking the board and BMC. Not universal across X10-X13; X10QBi and newer OpenBMC stacks need different adapters. Auto restore selects Standard mode.

entries.description: Selected X9 ATEN boards, four zones, 0-255 scaling
entries.constraints: Only some X9 boards support this sequence; select explicitly after verifying the exact board. Standard mode used on restore.

entries.description: xFusion / 超聚变 (legacy Huawei FusionServer) standard IPMI monitoring (no fan writes)
entries.constraints: Standard IPMI monitoring. Preserve original Huawei/xFusion manufacturer IDs and FRU identity across product transitions. iBMC WebUI/SSH thermal features do not prove an IPMI write/recovery sequence.

entries.description: ZTE / 中兴通讯 standard IPMI monitoring (no fan writes)
entries.constraints: Standard IPMI monitoring when supported/enabled on the installed BMC. Do not infer duty encoding or automatic restoration from vendor name or a WebUI fan policy.
Separate conflicting model/firmware interfaces before enabling writes
Nuvoton TMFR register setup and 0x5c interface
OpenBMC versus ATEN stack discovery, per-stack release and zone discovery
Control may need modified firmware or SSH, outside this version's protocol scope
Vendor documents fan settings; full IPMI write/restore sequence not established here
